erc_split_scope.author: jochem-brouwer
erc_split_scope.excerpt: I am not entirely sure if we should do this. The main problem I see is if an EIP/ERC introduces new vocabulary. Do we expect authors to add these words to the "known words" list? This directly adds that word as "known word" for *all EIPs/ERCs* which is not correct because it only applies to specific EIPs. It will also mean that the known words for ERCs/EIPs diverge as adding a word to known words in EIPs will not add to ERCs. Not sure if this is a big problem though.
